overview: Tailors Walk is home to Katta’s textile artisans, producing clothing, ceremonial attire, and reinforced fabrics.
history: Founded to centralize textile production and civic garment crafting.
Guild halls were established to regulate quality and ceremonial standards.
Arcane stitchwrights introduced resonance‑thread for reinforced fabrics.
The district expanded to support Artisan Row and the Residential Quarter.
hooks: A ceremonial garment order for the Senate is behind schedule.
A rare fabric shipment goes missing from the dye house.
Arcane sewing tools malfunction across the district.
A tailor reports strange resonance pulses in their studio.
